messages.content: The display-case work has slipped. Final object placement is now Thursday morning, so I need to stay Wednesday night and move only the return flight to Thursday. I should be released around noon.

I’ll leave the Monday, July 20 ATL-STL flight unchanged and check Thursday, July 23 returns that allow time to get from the museum to STL. I’ll also see whether the Drury Plaza at the Arch can extend your current reservation through Thursday without changing rooms.
Please avoid anything that would require leaving the museum before noon. What are the workable flight choices?

There are two Delta nonstops that fit: 3:36 p.m.-6:10 p.m. for an $84.20 fare increase, or 7:52 p.m.-10:24 p.m. for a $46.80 increase. The earlier flight gives you about two hours to reach the airport and clear security if you leave the museum at noon. A standard Main Cabin aisle seat is currently available on each option.
Use the 3:36. I don’t want to spend the whole afternoon waiting after the installation is finished. Is the hotel able to add Wednesday night?

The hotel has limited inventory, but it can add Wednesday, July 22 in the same room type. The added night is $214.06 including taxes, bringing the hotel total from $391.64 to $605.70. The hotel can link the nights as one continuous stay, so you would not need to check out or move rooms Wednesday.
Does extending it change the cancellation terms on the first two nights?

No. The original July 20-22 portion keeps its existing cancellation deadline of 6:00 p.m. local time on July 19. The added Wednesday night is refundable until 6:00 p.m. local time on July 21. After those respective deadlines, the applicable night charges become nonrefundable.
Before you change anything, give me the revised full total and make sure the Wednesday flight value is being applied rather than lost.

The original airline ticket value is fully applied to the exchange. Moving the return from Wednesday at 8:28 p.m. to Thursday at 3:36 p.m. adds $84.20, making the revised airfare $473.20. The extended hotel total is $605.70, and the existing $76.00 ground-transportation allowance remains unchanged. The revised trip total is $1,154.90, which is $298.26 above the confirmed itinerary. There is no separate airline change fee.
And the Monday outbound, passenger details, and cabin all stay exactly as booked?

Yes. The Monday, July 20 flight remains the 6:18 p.m. nonstop from ATL to STL in Main Cabin, with the current passenger details and seat assignment untouched. Only the return date, flight, and return-seat assignment will change.
All right. Confirm the Thursday 3:36 p.m. return with the available aisle seat, and add Wednesday night at the Drury in the same room. Do both changes now.

Both changes are confirmed. Delta confirmation D6R8KP now shows the unchanged Monday 6:18 p.m. ATL-STL outbound and the Thursday, July 23 3:36 p.m. STL-ATL nonstop return, arriving at 6:10 p.m.; Main Cabin aisle seat 18C is assigned on the return. The airfare is $473.20 after applying the original ticket value. Drury confirmation DP-720436 has been extended through Thursday, July 23 in the same room, with no checkout or room move on Wednesday; the hotel total is $605.70. With the unchanged $76.00 ground allowance, the revised trip total is $1,154.90.
